title: security: rbac v2 - KMS region residency enforcement and audit enhancements
author: Aisha Patel
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated regions require that encryption keys and the use of those keys remain resident in-stated cloud regions. This PR extends RBAC v2 to enforce KMS region residency rules, and improves audit logging so KMS-related events include key identifiers, resolved region, and enforcement outcomes. This enables both policy compliance and post-incident forensic analysis.

What this PR does: 1) Add a KMS residency enforcement check to the RBAC v2 policy evaluation pipeline (configurable in audit/enforce modes). 2) Emit structured audit fields for KMS events: kms_key_id, kms_key_region, kms_operation, policy_match, enforcement_result. 3) Provide a migration job to backfill existing resources with explicit residency metadata and to detect policy violations before enforcement. 4) Add end-to-end tests and unit tests for region resolution and policy precedence. 5) Docs and example Linear/Jira links for customers who need to opt into enforcement.

Testing and rollout: - Default rollout is audit mode (rbac_v2_kms_residency: "audit") for two weeks to surface policy violations in the audit logs. - After monitoring, the feature flag will be switched to "enforce" per org, starting with orgs in the EU region and then US. - Migration job is run as a one-off via migration CLI (pkg/migrations/kms_residency_migration.go). - CI includes unit tests, integration tests against a KMS mock, and e2e runs in perf-canary.

Checklist:
- [x] Add enforcement and audit hooks to RBAC v2 evaluation pipeline
- [x] Emit kms metadata in audit events
- [x] Migration/backfill job and dry-run mode
- [x] E2E tests and unit tests
- [x] Docs and console UI copy for rollout
- [x] Performance validation under continuous batching

Related: ENG-4521, SEC-210, SUP-2349. For customers requiring immediate opt-out, set rbac_v2_kms_residency = "off" on the org. Full rollout plan is tracked in ENG-4521.

release_notes: RBAC v2: Add configurable KMS region residency enforcement (audit then enforce rollout). Audit logs now include kms_key_id, kms_key_region, kms_operation and enforcement_result to support compliance reporting and investigations. Includes migration tool to backfill residency metadata and accompanying tests and docs.
notes: Rollout instructions in ENG-4521 — start audit mode for 2 weeks before enforcing per-org.
Backport planned for release-2025.11; see label backport:release-2025.11.
Customers can opt-out by setting rbac_v2_kms_residency = "off" at the org level.
